schema_doc: Canonical paragraph-level corrections registry. Source of truth for all manual edits applied on top of the immutable FB2 source. Pipeline: fb2_remake.fb2 → parse → text_corrections.json → apply → remake_data.js / book_text.md.

Removed 3 spurious pending items (§13 stamina+15, §140 gold+30, §532 wound_2 — first two were misinterpretations of paragraph-arithmetic mechanics, third was already implemented in src/remake_data.js + src/game_logic.js). Corrected §166 canonical branch set. Registered ~25 new pending items across 4 categories: gold-sign data bugs, missing passive auto-effects, missing item acquisitions, conditional-choice gating, and the dynamic-target paragraph-arithmetic engine cluster.
version_history.v2 → v2.1: May 2026 sweep against current MJ_MAP and art_catalog.py state revealed that all Group 4 art-mapping recommendations from both audits were already in place: §1072 already maps to art09_sleeping_princess; art12_camp/art29_hostess/art41_mounted catalogues already match MJ_MAP; §319/§100/§558/§846/§1123 already use the recommended arts. The audits were taken before previous sessions had already cleaned up these mappings. Items recorded in resolved_no_op below as verified-and-resolved so future audits don't resurrect them.
version_history.v2.1 → v2.2: May 2026 mid-session sweep: registered three findings discovered while applying Group 1 deferred (white arrow) and Group 6 (Vodyanoy paradox). Each is a non-blocker but should not be lost: §874 silver bracelet has no acquisition path; bronze whistle is granted under three different name strings; §1122 partial inventory loss (knives) is narrative-only. Added as pending groups 11, 12, 13.
version_history.v2.2 → v2.3: May 2026 investigation deepened group_11 (silver bracelet). FB2 search confirmed there is no auto-acquisition paragraph for 'Серебряный браслет'. The item is purchased from the peasant's shop in §340 along with 8 other items. §340 in remake_data.js has the FB2 text describing the shop but no purchase mechanism — only 3 navigation choices (leave west / south / stay). This is a symptom of a missing shop/buy-choice engine feature, not a single-paragraph fix. Group 11 reclassified as architectural; new group_14 added to track the shop-mechanic gap across the book.
version_history.v2.3 → v2.4: May 2026 — Group 12 (bronze whistle) partially closed: 2 name rationalizations applied + 3 offer-paragraphs gated by inventory_condition. The post-combat acquisition half of group_12 (7 paragraphs where the player kills a goblin and then takes the whistle from the corpse) cannot be closed without a new engine feature, because auto_items applies on first paragraph entry, before combat resolves. Registered as new group_15.
version_history.v2.4 → v2.5: May 2026 — group_13 reclassified after FB2 verification. The Gemini graph audit had read the §1122 «ножей и след простыл» line as inventory loss of knife-class items, but FB2 review shows the knives were never inventory items at all — they were an attack effect from a previous trap paragraph causing wounds. The §1122 effect is the canonical −5 STAMINA cost the canon states explicitly («вычесть 5 ВЫНОСЛИВОСТЕЙ за те раны»), so this is a Group 1.3-class missing auto-effect, not a Group 7-class inventory loss. Applied auto_items.stamina_sub=5 and moved registry entry from pending_corrections to resolved_no_op with the corrected interpretation. The lose_substring engine extension idea originally floated in group_13 is no longer needed for this paragraph (and there are no other knife-loss paragraphs in the data either).
version_history.v2.5 → v2.6: May 2026 — registry hygiene sweep. Seven groups had been closed by commits across the recent sessions but were still listed in pending_corrections, making the backlog look bigger than it is. Closed groups now carry status_done with their commit hashes. Two diagnostic-only groups (9 combat balance, 10 spell economy) moved to resolved_no_op as design notes — not bugs. Net effect: pending_corrections now lists only items that genuinely need future work.

New engine field 'acquires' added to choice schema: a choice may carry an item name (string) or array of names, deposited into S.inventory when the player clicks the button. Uses existing showInventoryModal for 7-slot overflow handling. Applied to 6 paragraphs (§58, §69, §233, §250, §567, §717). Three of those also gained the missing post_combat:true flag so the button only appears after combat resolves. Smoke-test scenarios extended to cover all 6.

Applied to §340 (peasant shop, 9 items: 3 food + 6 inventory items). This unblocks group_11 (silver bracelet — granted by §340 at 4g) and group_17 (figurine key — granted by §340 at 2g). schema_fields.type: Optional taxonomy: ocr | typo | missing_space | gameplay_logic | disambiguation | broken_target | sign_bug | missing_auto_effect | missing_item | conditional_choice | dynamic_target | dead_end_crash

group_14_shop_buy_choice_engine.comment: Several paragraphs across the book describe a shop-style merchant selling multiple items at named prices, but the engine has no purchase choice type. group_15_post_combat_item_grants.comment: Several paragraphs use a 'kill enemy, then take their item' pattern. Currently the only way to express this in data is auto_items.items, which applies on first entry — too early, because the player hasn't yet won the combat. Result: the post_combat choice button says 'Взять X и идти дальше' but X never enters inventory. Found during Group 12 (whistle) work, but the pattern is general and applies to every loot-from-corpse scenario in the book. Need new engine feature.
design_options: Option A: new auto_items_after_combat field. Engine applies it when sec.enemies && combatDone[S.section] becomes true, rather than on firstVisit. Symmetric with existing auto_items.

Option B: new acquires field on choice. choice = {target, label, acquires: ['Бронзовый свисток']}. Engine deposits items at the moment the player clicks the choice. More flexible — different post-combat choices could grant different items (e.g. 'take whistle' vs 'leave whistle').
Option C: paragraph splitting — introduce a synthetic intermediate paragraph between combat and the next location, and put auto_items on it. Heavy data refactor; not recommended.

group_16_gold_condition_gating.comment: Some paragraphs offer the player a choice that costs a specific amount of gold (e.g. §774: 'если есть 1 золотой — открыть дверь монетой', 'если есть 5 золотых — попробовать открыть большой сундук'). The engine has no way to gate a choice by gold-on-hand and no way to deduct the cost on click. Currently the buttons show regardless of gold balance, and clicking does not subtract. Resolution requires a new choice-level field gold_condition:N (button rendered only when S.gold>=N) and gold_cost:N (deduct on click — could reuse acquires' onclick wrapper). canonical_notes.FORCE: FB2 canon: "Прибавит вам силу и увеличит вашу СИЛУ УДАРА в бою." Persistent buff applied to player attack math for whole combat duration. Implementation: combatState.forceBuff=true, pMod += 2 in combatRound. Single cast per combat (re-click prevented).
canonical_notes.WEAKNESS: FB2 canon varies: "Сделает вашего врага неуклюжим и неповоротливым, ослабит СИЛУ его УДАРА" (general) and "уменьшите на 2 СИЛУ УДАРА любого из Гоблинов" (single target in multi-enemy fights). Engine applies -2 globally to all active enemies because per-round attack math doesn't track which single enemy was targeted; slightly more generous than canon for multi-enemy fights but matches the spirit of "ослабляет врага в этом бою".
canonical_notes.COPY: Pre-existing implementation (commit aeebe69) clones the strongest active enemy and runs auto-combat between clone and original. Unchanged by group_19.

canonical_notes.HEALING_combat: NOT IMPLEMENTED as combat-modal. HEALING is engine-global HUD #btn-heal restricted to NON-combat moments per spell definition ("В любой момент (но не во время сражения)"). Player can use HEALING between combats to restore stamina.
